title: Thai-Style Pork Knuckle Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish featuring a slow-cooked pork knuckle wrapped in a crispy springy wrap.

ingredients.name: Magical spice blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of your favorite Thai spices

instructions: Season the pork knuckle with 1 tsp of Magical spice blend and a pinch of salt.
Roast the pork knuckle in the oven for 30 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, heat 1 tbsp of Coconut oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped Russian dill and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Warm the Springy wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds, or until pliable.
Assemble the wrap by spreading a layer of Sriracha sauce (if using) on the wrap, followed by a slice of the roasted pork, a sprinkle of chopped Russian dill, and a drizzle of Fish sauce (if using).
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
